newsitem.title: USA: Bill Cosby's son found shot dead - police.
newsitem.headline: Bill Cosby's son found shot dead - police.

text.p: The only son of comedian Bill Cosby was found shot dead on Thursday next to his car near a Los Angeles freeway, police said.
Ennis Cosby, believed to be in his 20s, was killed apparently after he stopped to fix a flat tire, Los Angeles police Cmdr. Tim McBride said.
He said a woman saw at least part of the early morning attack and that she described the gunman as a white male. A police source said he died of a single gunshot wound.

In a statement released by his publicist, Cosby, a top star of television and film comedy, said: "We have every confidence in the LAPD (Los Angeles Police Department) ... This is a life experience that is truly difficult to share."
Cosby was in New York and notified earlier on Thursday of his son's death.
McBride said robbery may have been the motive but "it doesn't appear that anything was taken at this time."
He said Cosby may have been followed to the scene and appeared to have made at least one call on his cellular phone before the attack.
"I have just talked to Mr. Cosby in New York. He certainly has seen some significant grief," McBride said. "He ... asked us to do anything possible to find and locate and prosecute the suspect."
CBS radio reported Cosby appeared outside his apartment in Manhattan, looking red-eyed.
He shook his head as reporters asked for comment, then said, "He was my hero," before returning inside.
